items.label: lev_4b_vs_jev
items.note: lev: open System One model, LoRA on Qwen3.5-4B (weights interfaze-ai/lev); needs a lev source adapter using its own runtime

items.label: jevstyle_2b_vs_jev
items.note: Qwen3.5-2B finetune that answers System One requests; harness has no Qwen3.5 text-gen readout adapter

items.label: jevstyle_0p8b_vs_jev
items.note: Qwen3.5-0.8B finetune that answers System One requests; same missing adapter as the 2B

items.label: raz_systemone_nli_xs_vs_jev
items.note: open System One NLI cross-encoder (deberta-v2-xsmall); needs a cross-encoder adapter

items.label: jevstyle_cascade_9b_vs_jev
items.note: Jev-Style cascade: Jev-Style-2B-Decision-v3 answers first, JevK5-9B takes the unsure questions; claims 87.9% on JevBench public items (Jev 86.6%). Needs a jev-style source (jev-style[torch] >= 0.4.0 + jevk5 runtime, both tiers resident on one >= 32 GB GPU); same missing jev-style adapter as the proposed jevstyle_2b

items.label: gutsy_0p8b_vs_jev
items.note: gutsy-0.8b v0.4 (kouhxp/gutsy): Qwen3.5-0.8B decision fine-tune, calibrated, shipped as Q8_0 / Q4_K_M GGUF behind its own gutsy-inference runtime (llama-cpp-python, /v1/systemone), not llama-server's decision endpoint; needs a gutsy source adapter

items.label: openjevx_vs_jev
items.note: OpenJevX v0.5.2 (HF muthuishere/openjevx): Laya ModernBERT-large fine-tune with its own calibration temperatures, Laya-format checkpoint (model.safetensors, encoder/, tokenizer/, rl_agent_config.json); the laya source only loads the three checkpoints of the pinned convaiinnovations/laya bundle (LAYA_SUBFOLDER), so it needs a laya-source entry for an external repo + revision (batched via forward_batch 64 like Laya)

items.label: anarkali_150m_vs_jev
items.note: Anarkali 150M (HF toufiqqureshi651/anarkali, Apache-2.0): open typed-decision model, a new family, shipped as ONNX (model.onnx + tokenizer.json + anarkali.json) behind its own Jev-compatible /v1/systemone runtime; the harness has no onnxruntime source. Needs an anarkali source (onnxruntime-gpu, batched forward over many request bodies per call)

items.label: autotrust_jev9b_vs_jev
items.note: AutoTrust JEV-9B (Qwen3.5-9B + LoRA + the same 24-slot decision head / calibration.json layout as the benchmarked JEV-27B): the autotrust source pins model autotrust/JEV-27B and its revision (AutoTrustSource.model Literal, AUTOTRUST_REVISION, H200 GPU map); needs the 9B id + revision b63f651 and an L40S/H100 entry. 27B ran at $79.85/1k, so a 9B is the one that could get under the $63/1k line

items.label: decima_small_vs_jev
items.note: Decima 1.1 (amyrmahdy/decima-small, Apache-2.0): new open 122M Jev-style decision model family, ONNX int8 behind its own TypeSafe-compatible /v1/systemone runtime (python -m decima.serve); the harness has no onnxruntime source. Needs a decima source (onnxruntime-gpu, forward_batch over many request bodies per call)

items.label: startlux_decision_4b_vs_jev
items.note: StartLux-Decision size the startlux source cannot load: StartLuxSource.model and STARTLUX_REVISION pin only startlux-models/StartLux-Decision-9B; needs the 4B id + revision 9302aed and a GPU entry (L40S/H100). JevBench public 204/231; a 4B is the StartLux size most likely to get under the $63/1k line

items.label: kahn1_4b_vs_jev
items.note: Kahn1 4B (HF Okura66/Kahn1-Qwen3.5-4B @f3f9910, Apache-2.0): new open System One family, Qwen3.5-4B fine-tune that reads typed answers from option-token probabilities with calibrated confidence; served by its own sysone runtime on vLLM (POST /v1/evaluate/jev, not /v1/systemone). Needs a kahn1 source (vLLM in-process or sysone server, batched via server-side concurrency) - no harness source loads it

items.label: rsi_jev_v5_vl_3b_vs_jev
items.note: RSI-Jev v5.0-VL 3B (first 20 of Qwen3.5-4B-Base's 32 layers + option-scoring head, own-token pooling, calibration.safetensors): the rsi_jev source pins only shgao/rsi-jev-v3.0-qwen3.5-2b (RsiJevSource.model Literal); needs the v5.0-vl-3b id + revision 66eeaee and rsi-jev[fast,vision] in the image (text-only cases, batched via forward_batch like v3.0)

items.label: rizzo_flow_4b_vs_jev
items.note: points at Rizzo Flow (HF rizzoaiacademy/rizzo-flow @55633c8, Apache-2.0): new open typed-decision family, Spark-X2.5-4B (and 1.7B) + LoRA, answer = softmax over answer-letter logits at the last prompt position; served by its own `rizzo serve` llama.cpp runtime (Q8_0 GGUF) or the merged BF16 checkpoint with trust_remote_code (modeling_spark.py). Needs a rizzo source (its prompt + letter-logit readout, batched forward or llama-server slots); 4B is within the budget line

items.label: kenning_large_v04_vs_jev
